test_cases.title: Exploratory evaluation of core product functionality and user value delivery

steps: Explore key user workflows across the product interface without a rigid script.

test_cases.expected_result: Product enables smooth task execution and delivers clear functional utility without major usability blockers or unexpected failures.

test_cases.title: Exploratory assessment of product usability and user feedback mechanisms
test_cases.preconditions: Product is accessible with test accounts having default permissions.
steps: Navigate critical paths and secondary product features from the perspective of a new user.

Assess user experience quality, system responsiveness, and overall value perception.
test_cases.expected_result: System provides intuitive navigation, helpful error feedback, and clear output that supports user satisfaction and perceived value.
